title: Carry out
subtitle: 「執行／進行／實施／完成」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「執行／進行／實施／完成」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 carry out 非常接近，尤其常用於研究、調查、實驗、測試、訪談等正式活動。
words.example: The researchers conducted a survey among university students.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員在大學生中進行了一項調查。

exercises.original: The researchers carried out a survey among university students.
exercises.zh: 研究人員在大學生中進行了一項調查。
exercises.upgrade: The researchers conducted a survey among university students.

options.explanation: conduct a survey 是正式、自然的固定搭配。
只是計劃調查，未必真的進行。
只表示試圖進行，未必成功完成。
表示觀察，不等於進行整項調查。

exercises.original: The laboratory carried out several experiments last month.
exercises.zh: 實驗室上月進行了幾項實驗。
exercises.upgrade: The laboratory conducted several experiments last month.

options.explanation: 只表示設計實驗，不代表已執行。

exercises.original: Police carried out an investigation into the incident.
exercises.zh: 警方就事件進行調查。
exercises.upgrade: Police conducted an investigation into the incident.

words.note: 常用於任務、程序、測試、手術、操作等。
words.example: The technician performed a series of safety checks.
words.exampleZh: 技術員進行了一系列安全檢查。

exercises.original: The technician carried out a series of safety checks.
exercises.zh: 技術員進行了一系列安全檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The technician performed a series of safety checks.

options.explanation: 檢查、測試、程序很常用 perform。

exercises.original: The surgeon carried out the procedure successfully.
exercises.zh: 外科醫生成功進行了該項程序。
exercises.upgrade: The surgeon performed the procedure successfully.

options.explanation: perform a procedure 是醫療常見搭配。

exercises.original: Staff carried out routine maintenance on the equipment.
exercises.zh: 員工對設備進行例行維修。
exercises.upgrade: Staff performed routine maintenance on the equipment.

words.note: 表示接受某項工作、任務、研究或項目並開始執行。
words.example: The university undertook a major review of its admissions policy.
words.exampleZh: 大學展開了一項大型招生政策檢討。

exercises.original: The university carried out a major review of its admissions policy.
exercises.zh: 大學展開了一項大型招生政策檢討。
exercises.upgrade: The university undertook a major review of its admissions policy.

options.explanation: 正式地表示承擔並進行一項大型工作。

exercises.original: The company carried out extensive renovation work.
exercises.zh: 公司進行了大規模翻新工程。
exercises.upgrade: The company undertook extensive renovation work.

options.explanation: 大型工程／工作非常適合 undertake。

exercises.original: The research team carried out a five-year study.
exercises.zh: 研究團隊進行了一項為期五年的研究。
exercises.upgrade: The research team undertook a five-year study.

options.explanation: 長期研究工作中很自然。

words.note: 較正式，表示精確地執行命令、計劃、操作或策略。
words.example: The team executed the plan exactly as instructed.
words.exampleZh: 團隊完全按照指示執行計劃。

exercises.original: The team carried out the plan exactly as instructed.
exercises.zh: 團隊完全按照指示執行計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The team executed the plan exactly as instructed.

options.explanation: 強調準確地執行既定計劃。

exercises.original: The unit carried out the command immediately.
exercises.zh: 該單位立即執行命令。
exercises.upgrade: The unit executed the command immediately.

options.explanation: execute a command 是固定搭配。

exercises.original: The dancers carried out the movement with precision.
exercises.zh: 舞者精確地完成這個動作。
exercises.upgrade: The dancers executed the movement with precision.

options.explanation: 技巧性動作配 execute 很自然。

words.note: 當 carry out 指政策、制度、措施、程序或計劃開始真正運作時，implement 很自然。
words.example: The school implemented a new attendance policy.
words.exampleZh: 學校實施了一項新的出勤政策。

exercises.original: The school carried out a new attendance policy.
exercises.zh: 學校實施了一項新的出勤政策。
exercises.upgrade: The school implemented a new attendance policy.

options.explanation: 政策正式開始運作時最自然。

exercises.original: The company carried out several cost-saving measures.
exercises.zh: 公司實施了多項節省成本措施。
exercises.upgrade: The company implemented several cost-saving measures.

options.explanation: measures + actual action 最適合 implement。

exercises.original: The hospital carried out the new safety procedure across all departments.
exercises.zh: 醫院在所有部門實施新的安全程序。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital implemented the new safety procedure across all departments.

options.explanation: 制度性程序正式推行，非常自然。

words.note: 當重點是「把工作做完」而不是「進行過程」時，complete 很接近。
words.example: The team completed the inspection before noon.
words.exampleZh: 團隊在中午前完成檢查。

exercises.original: The team carried out the inspection before noon and finished it.
exercises.zh: 團隊在中午前完成檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The team completed the inspection before noon.

options.explanation: 原句明確強調 finished，因此 complete 最準確。

exercises.original: Workers carried out all the repairs by Friday.
exercises.zh: 工人在星期五前完成所有維修。
exercises.upgrade: Workers completed all the repairs by Friday.

options.explanation: by Friday 強調在期限前完成。
只檢查，沒有表示維修完成。

exercises.original: She carried out the assignment and submitted it on time.
exercises.zh: 她完成作業並準時提交。
exercises.upgrade: She completed the assignment and submitted it on time.

words.note: 表示成功完成任務、工作或目標。
words.example: The engineers accomplished the task ahead of schedule.
words.exampleZh: 工程師提前完成了任務。

exercises.original: The engineers carried out the difficult task successfully.
exercises.zh: 工程師成功完成了艱巨任務。
exercises.upgrade: The engineers accomplished the difficult task successfully.

exercises.original: The team carried out everything it had set out to do.
exercises.zh: 團隊完成了原本打算完成的一切。
exercises.upgrade: The team accomplished everything it had set out to do.

options.explanation: 表示成功達成預定工作。

exercises.original: They carried out a challenging mission despite limited resources.
exercises.zh: 儘管資源有限，他們仍成功完成艱巨任務。
exercises.upgrade: They accomplished a challenging mission despite limited resources.

options.explanation: 帶有成功克服困難完成任務的意味。

words.note: 常用於責任、義務、承諾、職責。
words.example: All staff are expected to fulfil their duties professionally.
words.exampleZh: 所有員工都應專業地履行職責。

exercises.original: Employees are expected to carry out their duties professionally.
exercises.zh: 員工應專業地履行職責。
exercises.upgrade: Employees are expected to fulfil their duties professionally.

options.explanation: fulfil duties 是非常自然的固定搭配。

exercises.original: The organization must carry out its legal obligations.
exercises.zh: 機構必須履行法律義務。
exercises.upgrade: The organization must fulfil its legal obligations.

options.explanation: obligations 與 fulfil 搭配非常自然。
義務不是被「提出」就算履行。

exercises.original: She carried out the responsibilities of the role effectively.
exercises.zh: 她有效履行了該職位的責任。
exercises.upgrade: She fulfilled the responsibilities of the role effectively.

words.note: 較正式，尤其用於 duties / responsibilities / obligations。
words.example: Officials must discharge their duties fairly.
words.exampleZh: 官員必須公平履行職責。

exercises.original: Officials must carry out their duties fairly.
exercises.zh: 官員必須公平履行職責。
exercises.upgrade: Officials must discharge their duties fairly.

exercises.original: The board carried out its responsibilities under the law.
exercises.zh: 董事會依法履行責任。
exercises.upgrade: The board discharged its responsibilities under the law.

options.explanation: 法律／正式管理語境自然。

exercises.original: She carried out her responsibilities as chairperson.
exercises.zh: 她履行了主席職責。
exercises.upgrade: She discharged her responsibilities as chairperson.

words.note: 當 carry out 指把知識、方法、原則或技巧真正用起來時，非常自然。
words.example: The training taught staff how to put the new procedures into practice.
words.exampleZh: 培訓教員工如何把新程序付諸實行。

exercises.original: The staff carried out the new techniques they had learned in training.
exercises.zh: 員工把培訓中學到的新技巧付諸實踐。
exercises.upgrade: The staff put into practice the new techniques they had learned in training.

options.explanation: 把學到的技巧真正用起來，最自然。

exercises.original: Students were asked to carry out the principles learned in class.
exercises.zh: 學生被要求把課堂學到的原則付諸實踐。
exercises.upgrade: Students were asked to put into practice the principles learned in class.

options.explanation: principles + real-world use 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: The company carried out its new working methods across the team.
exercises.zh: 公司把新的工作方法付諸實行。
exercises.upgrade: The company put its new working methods into practice across the team.

options.explanation: methods 真正被使用時非常自然。
方法不是「草擬」後就等於實行。

words.note: 表示讓政策、規例、措施或安排正式開始運作。
words.example: The new rules will be put into effect next month.
words.exampleZh: 新規則將於下月正式實施。

exercises.original: The government will carry out the new regulations next month.
exercises.zh: 政府將於下月實施新規例。
exercises.upgrade: The government will put the new regulations into effect next month.

options.explanation: 表示規例正式開始生效。

exercises.original: The company carried out the new policy from January 1.
exercises.zh: 公司由一月一日起正式實施新政策。
exercises.upgrade: The company put the new policy into effect from January 1.

options.explanation: 明確起始日期是「正式生效」的強線索。

exercises.original: Emergency measures were carried out immediately.
exercises.zh: 緊急措施立即開始實施。
exercises.upgrade: Emergency measures were put into effect immediately.

options.explanation: measures 正式開始運作，最自然。

words.note: 表示不只是作出承諾或開始做，而是繼續執行直到真正完成。
words.example: The company must follow through on its promise to improve safety.
words.exampleZh: 公司必須貫徹改善安全的承諾。

exercises.original: The company must carry out its promise to improve safety.
exercises.zh: 公司必須貫徹改善安全的承諾。
exercises.upgrade: The company must follow through on its promise to improve safety.

options.explanation: 表示承諾後真的採取行動並做到底。
只是作出承諾，不表示履行。

exercises.original: He said he would reduce costs and then carried out that commitment.
exercises.zh: 他說會降低成本，之後也確實貫徹了這項承諾。
exercises.upgrade: He followed through on that commitment.

options.explanation: 表示從承諾到真正行動。

exercises.original: The council carried out the pledge it made during the consultation.
exercises.zh: 議會貫徹了諮詢期間作出的承諾。
exercises.upgrade: The council followed through on the pledge it made during the consultation.

options.explanation: pledge / promise / commitment 是典型搭配。

words.note: 表示根據建議、指示、資訊或決定採取實際行動。
words.example: The manager acted on the recommendations in the report.
words.exampleZh: 經理根據報告中的建議採取了行動。

exercises.original: The manager carried out the recommendations in the report.
exercises.zh: 經理根據報告中的建議採取了行動。
exercises.upgrade: The manager acted on the recommendations in the report.

options.explanation: act on recommendations 表示根據建議採取實際行動。

exercises.original: Staff carried out the instructions they received from management.
exercises.zh: 員工按管理層的指示採取行動。
exercises.upgrade: Staff acted on the instructions they received from management.

options.explanation: 指根據 instructions 採取實際行動。

exercises.original: The board carried out the advice of its legal team.
exercises.zh: 董事會根據法律團隊的建議採取行動。
exercises.upgrade: The board acted on the advice of its legal team.

options.explanation: act on advice 是固定自然搭配。

falseSynonyms.zh: 計劃不等於執行 plan 是決定怎樣做； carry out 是真正去做。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They planned the experiment. They carried out the experiment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 嘗試不等於完成執行 attempt 只表示試圖做，可能失敗。
安排不等於執行 arrange 表示組織、安排資源或時間； carry out 表示真正執行。
制定／發展不等於實施 你可以 develop a policy，但還沒有 implement it。
只有在「完成」語境才接近 complete 強調終點； carry out 可以只描述執行過程。
詞性陷阱 - perform = 動詞，執行 - performance = 名詞，表現／演出
詞性陷阱 - implement = 動詞，實施 - implementation = 名詞，實施
詞義與詞形不同 - conduct = 進行 - conducting = 進行中的動作／指揮 - conduction = 傳導 conduction 不能代替 conduct。
